Manage ArgoCD RBAC, SSO integration, and security hardening. Collaborate with development teams to onboard services into the GitOps delivery model. Design Jenkins declarative and scripted pipelines for complex multi-stage deployments across environments. Integrate Jenkins with container registries, artifact repositories, testing frameworks, and deployment tools. Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions to standardize pipelines across teams. Create reusable Jenkins shared libraries and pipeline templates for consistency and maintainability. Integrate pipelines with container registries (Amazon ECR), security scanning tools (Trivy, Snyk, etc.), and deployment tooling. Implement pipeline best practices including secrets management, environment protection rules, and workflow approvals. Monitor pipeline performance and drive improvements in build reliability and deployment velocity. Design efficient container images that minimize size, reduce startup time, and optimize resource consumption. Manage container image repositories using Amazon ECR, including image lifecycle policies, tagging strategies, image retention policies, vulnerability scanning, and access control. Integrate container building and registry management into CI/CD pipelines, automating image builds, security scanning, tagging, and registry pushes.
